strings.arena.airfield_hangar.desc: An abandoned airstrip: boost down the runway and launch off the end.
strings.arena.championship_ring.desc: An elevated steel ring with a sweeper arm. The final word in ring-outs.
strings.arena.container_maze.desc: Night shift in a maze of shipping containers. Ambush every corner.
strings.arena.crane_pier.desc: A narrow pier deck high above the harbor in a storm. Push them into the sea.
strings.arena.crash_colosseum.desc: The league's grand stadium. Eighty thousand fans, floodlights and a dirt floor soaked in oil.
strings.arena.crusher_yard.desc: Four car crushers guard the hill. Hold the middle if you dare.
strings.arena.downtown_plaza.desc: Neon-lit downtown square. Taxis, buses and a fountain to bounce off.
strings.arena.dune_basin.desc: A vast sand basin ringed by rock pillars and launch pads.
strings.arena.foundry_floor.desc: Molten pits, hydraulic presses and swinging ladle cranes. Hot work.
strings.arena.frozen_lake.desc: Glare ice and ice-fishing huts. Brake early, slide sideways, T-bone everyone.
strings.arena.glacier_shelf.desc: A slick ice shelf hanging over a crevasse. One nudge and you're gone.
strings.arena.harbor_deck.desc: A container terminal with cranes overhead and stacks to climb.
strings.arena.highway_interchange.desc: A closed highway junction with a collapsed overpass gap to jump.
strings.arena.hub_ch1.desc: Lao Qin's home turf: mountains of scrap, hidden stashes and old derby legends.
strings.arena.hub_ch2.desc: Miles of quays and container canyons where Hook runs his smuggling crews.
strings.arena.hub_ch3.desc: Endless dunes, canyon mesas and the wrecks of racers who never made it back.
strings.arena.hub_ch4.desc: A frozen mountain pass with ice caves, logging camps and a frozen lake.
strings.arena.hub_ch5.desc: Ghost's city: back alleys, rooftop car parks and neon-lit boulevards.
strings.arena.hub_ch6.desc: Smokestacks, rail yards and live presses in Titan's industrial kingdom.
strings.arena.hub_ch7.desc: A glowing district of elevated plazas, sky bridges and pinball-bright streets.
strings.arena.hub_ch8.desc: The championship grounds around the Crash Colosseum: fan zones, practice pads and trophies.
strings.arena.junk_tower.desc: The flat top of a twenty-meter scrap tower. No walls. Long way down.
strings.arena.mesa_top.desc: A flat-topped mesa thirty-five meters above the desert floor.
strings.arena.neon_arcade.desc: A giant pinball table come to life: bumpers, spinners and a glowing hill.
strings.arena.neon_rooftop.desc: A skyscraper roof under a giant neon sign. Forty floors of free fall.
strings.arena.oasis_koth.desc: The only water for a hundred kilometers. Everyone wants the palms.
strings.arena.parking_rooftop.desc: Top deck of a car park at dusk. No railings were harmed in the making of this arena.
strings.arena.quarry_pit.desc: An open-cut quarry: rock shelves, dump trucks and sheer drops.
strings.arena.rust_bowl.desc: A dusty scrap-metal bowl where every rookie takes their first hit.
strings.arena.scrap_pit.desc: A sunken salvage yard with a bottomless crusher pit in the middle.
strings.arena.skyline_helipad.desc: A round helipad on the city's tallest tower. Hold the H or push them off it.
strings.arena.snow_fort.desc: A snow-walled fort with watchtowers. Take the courtyard and hold it.
strings.arena.steel_dome.desc: A symmetrical steel arena built for ranked duels: spinner, presses and pads.
strings.equip.ability_brace.desc: Locks the chassis for 3 s, halving all incoming damage. Cooldown 15 s.
strings.equip.ability_field_repair.desc: Restores 25% of every damage zone over 5 s. Cooldown 30 s.
strings.equip.ability_hydraulic_jump.desc: Hydraulic rams kick the car upward: dodge T-bones or drop onto a roof. Cooldown 8 s.
strings.equip.ability_nitro_burst.desc: Instantly refills 50 boost and adds 40% boost acceleration for 2 s. Cooldown 14 s.
strings.equip.ability_ram_charge.desc: For 2.5 s the front deals 1.6x damage and the engine pushes 30% harder. Cooldown 12 s.
strings.equip.ability_shock_bumper.desc: Charges the bumpers: your next contact within 3 s blasts the other car away. Cooldown 10 s.
strings.equip.core_autorepair.desc: Nano-weld swarm that keeps your car together mid-fight.
strings.equip.core_autorepair_basic.desc: An onboard welding robot that slowly patches damage during the fight.
strings.equip.core_ballast_lead.desc: Lead bricks under the floor. More mass, more momentum, lower center of gravity.
strings.equip.core_ballast_tungsten.desc: A tungsten slab that turns any car into a wrecking ball.
strings.equip.core_engine_shield.desc: A steel cage around the engine block. Keeps you running after big hits.
strings.equip.core_frame_reinforced.desc: Boxed frame rails and gusseted mounts. Every zone gets tougher.
strings.equip.core_frame_titanium.desc: Aerospace-grade titanium spaceframe. Tough as a tank, barely heavier.
strings.equip.core_gyro_stabilizer.desc: A flywheel stabilizer that fights rollovers and helps you land wheels-down.
strings.equip.core_lightweight_kit.desc: Gut the interior and swap panels for carbon. Faster, but a little more fragile.
strings.equip.core_shock_absorbers.desc: Hydraulic dampers on the bumper mounts that soak up your own impact damage.
strings.equip.front_bar_basic.desc: A welded steel bull bar. Cheap, honest, and made for your first head-on.
strings.equip.front_bar_heavy.desc: Police-spec push bar. Hits harder up front, but the extra weight dulls acceleration.
strings.equip.front_battering_ram.desc: A siege log capped in iron. Devastating head-ons, clumsy everywhere else.
strings.equip.front_cowcatcher.desc: Old-railroad grille that shoves cars aside and occasionally pops them into the air.
strings.equip.front_plow_snow.desc: A municipal plow blade. Pushes cars off ledges like fresh powder. Heavy vehicles only.
strings.equip.front_ram_spiked.desc: Hardened spikes that punch deep on head-ons and shred any tire they touch.
strings.equip.front_wedge_scorpion.desc: The ultimate launcher: a razor-flat wedge that turns every bump into a flight.
strings.equip.front_wedge_steel.desc: A low steel ramp that slides under bumpers and flips cars skyward. The classic launcher.
strings.equip.front_wedge_titanium.desc: Flatter, lighter and meaner than steel. Sends cars noticeably higher.
strings.equip.rear_bumper_crumple.desc: Honeycomb crash box that absorbs hits from behind and passes less shock to the cabin.
strings.equip.rear_bumper_reinforced.desc: Steel tube bumper that keeps rear-enders from reaching your fuel tank.
strings.equip.rear_bumper_tow.desc: A heavy hitch bumper. Rear-end it and you'll regret it.
strings.equip.rear_spikes_barbed.desc: Barbed steel tail that turns every PIT attempt against you into a flat tire for them.
strings.equip.rear_spikes_basic.desc: A row of spikes for anyone who tailgates. Tires that touch them pay for it.
strings.equip.roof_armor_heavy.desc: Crush-proof bunker roof. Top-heavy, so mind the corners.
strings.equip.roof_armor_plate.desc: A steel lid for when trucks try to land on you.
strings.equip.roof_cage_basic.desc: A bolt-in cage that keeps the roof up when you land upside down.
strings.equip.roof_cage_racing.desc: A welded chromoly cage that stiffens the whole shell.
strings.equip.roof_rollbar_titanium.desc: A titanium halo frame. Barely any weight, enormous strength.
strings.equip.side_blades_basic.desc: Short blades on the hubs that slice tires on contact. Rub panels, pop rubber.
strings.equip.side_blades_scythe.desc: Long curved hub scythes. Get alongside and the other car loses a wheel.
strings.equip.side_hubs_shredder.desc: Spinning hub cutters that turn every side-swipe into a blowout.
strings.equip.side_plates_composite.desc: Aramid-ceramic panels: better T-bone protection than steel at half the weight.
strings.equip.side_plates_steel.desc: Heavy plates bolted over the doors. Cheap T-bone insurance.
strings.equip.side_skirt_rubber.desc: Thick rubber skirts that bounce side-swipers away instead of absorbing the hit.
strings.equip.tire_chains.desc: Grip on ice and snow, a little bite on contact. Costs some top speed.
strings.equip.tire_offroad.desc: Chunky tread and tough sidewalls for dirt, sand and junk.
strings.equip.tire_runflat.desc: Reinforced tires that keep rolling after a blade attack.
strings.equip.tire_slicks.desc: Maximum grip on clean surfaces, but fragile under blades.
strings.equip.tire_spikes_basic.desc: Chariot-style hub spikes. Side contact chews through enemy tires.
strings.equip.tire_spikes_drill.desc: Spiralled drill bits on every hub. Brutal on side contact.
strings.mode.boss.desc: Chapter finale: defeat the rival and their crew to claim their signature car.
strings.mode.bounty.desc: The top scorer carries a bounty. Wreck them for a big payout — and once you wear the bounty, everyone hunts you.
strings.mode.derby.desc: Every car for itself, one life each. Wreck everyone; the last car still moving wins.
strings.mode.destruction.desc: Smash the required number of arena props before time runs out — and deal with anyone in the way.
strings.mode.explore.desc: Drive freely around the chapter hub, hunt collectibles and secrets, and raise your exploration score.
strings.mode.king_of_hill.desc: Two teams fight over the capture zone. First team to hold it for a total of 120 seconds wins.
strings.mode.ring_out.desc: A platform with no walls. Three lives each: knock rivals over the edge and be the last car standing.
strings.mode.survival.desc: Wave after wave of hostile cars. Survive until the clock runs out.
strings.mode.takedown.desc: Instant respawns. T-bones, launches and PITs all score; highest score when time runs out wins.
strings.mode.team_elimination.desc: Best of five rounds, no respawns within a round. Wipe out the enemy team to take the round. Ranked mode.
strings.mode.team_takedown.desc: Two teams, respawns on. First team to 30 takedowns wins, otherwise most takedowns at the buzzer.
strings.upg.armor.desc: Bolt-on steel plating that cuts damage from every side, at the cost of weight.
strings.upg.brakes.desc: Multi-piston calipers and drilled discs: brake later and dodge that lethal T-bone.
strings.upg.chassis.desc: Seam welding and extra bracing: every zone soaks more punishment.
strings.upg.engine.desc: Intake, exhaust and ECU work for more power and torque.
strings.upg.nitro.desc: Bigger bottles and faster refills: a ramming sprint whenever you need one.
strings.upg.suspension.desc: Coilovers and thicker anti-roll bars: lower, flatter and steadier on landings.
strings.upg.tires.desc: Stickier compounds and thicker sidewalls: more grip, tougher wheels.
strings.upg.transmission.desc: Stronger clutch and optimised ratios for punchier launches and a higher top end.
strings.upg.weight.desc: Strip seats and fit carbon panels: lighter and quicker, but easier to knock around.
